From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@evergreenhealth.com>

Subject: Onboarding checklist + initial MSA questions

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the intro last week. We're starting vendor setup for Redwood and I wanted to send our onboarding packet and call out a couple of items up front so we can align: 

- We're running Ariba as vendor portal; vendor registration requires a company DUNS and taxable entity match.
- Procurement policy requires a signed MSA + order form before we will issue POs. We typically redline a limited set of clauses (indemnity cap, data residency, invoice payment terms).
- PO acknowledgement SLA: Evergreen expects 48 hours for PO acknowledgement or we throttle payments.

Attached is our onboarding requirements PDF and our standard order form template — please confirm who on your side will own the MSA redline and the portal field mapping for PO legacy fields (PO number, line-level shipping codes, EDI ACK).

Also our Ariba vendor ID is 88-742-9931; we can add Redwood to our portal pending legal/ops sign-off.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Senior Sourcing Manager
Evergreen Health

Monica — thanks, reviewed the packet. High-level legal view and next actions: 

High-level legal notes:
- Evergreen's standard asks are within our normal tolerance, except the indemnity carve-outs around third-party data processors. We'll propose: keep their payment terms in the Order Form, narrow indemnity to direct damages and add mutual cap = 1x fees for a 12-month period.
- Request clarifications on data residency language; if they require EU-only processing we need to route to Private offering.
- PO acknowledgement SLA: operational term; not a legal blocker but need explicit service exceptions for scheduled maintenance and queued-batch processing.

Deliverables from Legal (I will own):
1) MSA mark with tracked changes and a short comment doc explaining redline choices (deliver by 11/12 EOD). Attachment: MSA_Redline_Guidance.docx (guidance + checklist).
2) Short Order Form amendment template to capture PO ack SLA, EDI manifest details, and billing contact.

Ops questions for Marissa/Rishi:
- Can we auto-ack POs in Ariba within 48h for standard orders? What's the current EDI ACK latency for similar customers?
- Are there any PO-line fields we cannot populate (tax jurisdiction, GL code) from our ERPs today?

I'll circulate the MSA mark once ready; Monica please set up an ops mapping call Thurs 11/13 10am PT if that works.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

2) Ops track (Marissa/Rishi) — field mapping call Thur 11/13 10am PT. Marissa to lead the Ariba/EDI mapping; Rishi to confirm PO ACK process and if we need a manual fallback for the first 2 weeks. Expected ops deliverable: mapping spreadsheet and list of exceptions by Fri 11/14.

- Please confirm the supplier invite was sent to supplier@redwood.ai (we use supplier@redwood.ai for portal onboarding).
